description: Resolve ENS names and Basenames both ways. name -> Ethereum address, Base address and profile records (avatar, description, url, email, Twitter/X, GitHub, Discord, Telegram) and whether it is that address's primary name; address -> its primary ENS name and primary Basename, each verified to resolve back to the same address. Works for .eth, *.base.eth, subnames and offchain (CCIP-Read) names. Unknown name or address = 404, not charged. Paid ($0.001, x402).

address.description: 0x address to find the primary name of. Use this or name

name.description: ENS name or Basename, e.g. vitalik.eth or jesse.base.eth (ASCII). Use this or address

name: resolve_name
title: resolve name
